source: Generated from commit 5551af1dc (before the network-confinement change) by buildSeatbeltProfile, buildSeatbeltShellProfile and linuxSocketDenyFilter.
generic:
(version 1)
;; Reads stay open: a toolchain loads from all over the filesystem, and an
;; allowlist wide enough to run Node is not a read boundary worth claiming.
(allow default)
;; Writes are the boundary.
(deny file-write*)
;; /dev is required for a process to have stdio at all.
(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper") (literal "/dev/tty"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "/nonexistent/amc-ws") (subpath "/nonexistent/amc-ws/out"))
genericEmpty:
(version 1)
;; Reads stay open: a toolchain loads from all over the filesystem, and an
;; allowlist wide enough to run Node is not a read boundary worth claiming.
(allow default)
;; Writes are the boundary.
(deny file-write*)
;; /dev is required for a process to have stdio at all.
(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper") (literal "/dev/tty"))
;; no writable roots
native:
(version 1)
;; Reads stay open except the deny-list below.
(allow default)
(deny file-write*)
(allow file-write* (subpath "/nonexistent/amc-ws/build") (subpath "/nonexistent/launch/tmp") (literal "/dev/null"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/nonexistent/amc-ws/.amc") (subpath "/nonexistent/home/.ssh") (subpath "/nonexistent/amc-ws/build/secret"))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal "/nonexistent/amc-ws/build"))
;; A hard link in a writable root to an outside file would write through to it.
(deny file-link)
(deny network*)
;; Nothing may ask launchd, LaunchServices or another app to start a process outside this profile.
(deny mach-lookup)
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.bsd.dirhelper" "com.apple.logd" "com.apple.system.notification_center" "com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.libinfo" "com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.membership"))
(deny lsopen)
(deny appleevent-send)
(deny job-creation)
(deny signal (target others))
(allow signal (target pgrp))
(deny process-info* (target others))
(deny process-exec (literal "/usr/bin/open") (literal "/usr/bin/osascript") (literal "/bin/launchctl") (literal "/usr/bin/at"))
;; Host state outside the write grants: named POSIX shared memory and System V IPC outlive the shell and reach other processes. The kernel still lets a System V segment be created; attaching it is denied.
(deny ipc-posix-shm-write-create ipc-posix-shm-write-data ipc-posix-shm-write-unlink)
(deny ipc-sysv*)
;; Kernel driver user clients (power management, displays, devices) are host state too; registry reads stay open.
(deny iokit-open)

;; Nothing may ask launchd, LaunchServices or another app to start a process outside this profile.
